description: Move a subtask to a different task within your organization. Both the subtask and the destination task must belong to your organization. Requires Manager role or above.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

new_task_id.description: ID of the destination task (required, must belong to your organization).

subtask_id.description: ID of the subtask to move (required).

name: move_subtask
